_README: Submission format for the research-area-persistence benchmark.
The validator refuses a submission that changes the split, reports a
subset of seeds, or selects on the test cohort, and it refuses before
computing a score, so a rejected submission never produces a number.
Every field below is required except the ones marked optional.
model_note: optional: architecture, features consumed, anything a reader needs

note: How the final model was chosen. split must not be 'test'.
The temporal validation cohort is the only cohort a submission may
select on: early stopping, hyperparameter choice, checkpoint choice.
The test cohort is scored once, after every choice has been made.

test_student_pid: the frozen temporal test split of this discipline, in order.
from utils import data as D; ds=D.temporal_split(D.load_dataset());
The validator compares this list for equality, order included.
test_labels: the frozen y of those same rows, in the same order, as integers 0 or 1.
The validator compares for equality. It is in the submission so that a
misalignment fails loudly here rather than silently shifting a score.

0: one probability per test student, same order, finite, in [0, 1]
_note: Exactly ten arrays, keyed '0' through '9'. An extra array means the
test cohort was scored more times than declared, which the validator
rejects. Scores are probabilities, not logits and not ranks; AUC-PR is
rank-based so a monotone transform is harmless, but the [0, 1] check
catches the common mistake of submitting logits.

_what_the_validator_does_next: After the six checks pass it scores the submission under eq. (2):
the ten-seed mean gap to the validation-symmetric ceiling M5', a paired
student-level bootstrap over 2000 draws, and three gates that must all
pass for a gain to count. Passing validation is not passing the gates.
p_BH from the validator corrects a family of one. The paper's tables
correct across the architecture family within a discipline; a submission
compared against those numbers should be corrected the same way.
